in_marathi.name: Sheelraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sheelraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sheelraj is a name derived from Sanskrit, where 'Sheel' means 'God of Wealth' and 'Raj' means 'King' or 'Rule'. This name is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
